name: Happy Path — REAL ID knowledge (no ID&V)

x_eval.persona: Jack Cabral, Massachusetts resident asking general REAL ID document questions. No personal record lookup needed.
x_eval.goal: Learn what documents Massachusetts REAL ID requires. Done when the agent answers with at least one concrete document category (identity, residency, or lawful status) from knowledge.

turns.text: What documents do I need to get a REAL ID at the Massachusetts RMV?

turns.note: Ask one brief follow-up only if the answer was empty or off-topic.

rubric.assertion: The agent named at least one REAL ID document requirement or category.
The agent invoked search_mv_knowledge for the REAL ID question.
The agent did not request identity verification for this general REAL ID question.
The answer was summarized in plain language without reading a long article verbatim.
